headline: Conferences coming up
text:
Conferences for your coverage from Fri Oct 9, 2026 to Fri Apr 30, 2027. Changes this week: 1 new, 2 with dates set, 2 with a covered company now presenting, 1 moved.

October 2026
- NOW PRESENTING: RCAT - Oct 15: ThinkEquity Conference, New York, NY. Presenting: RCAT. Small-cap investor day; Red Cat presented in 2025.
- Oct 12-14: AUSA Annual Meeting & Exposition 2026, Washington, DC. For RCAT, ONDS, DPRO. The Army's largest show; drone, counter-UAS and Army-buying news clusters here.

November 2026
- NEW - Nov 18: Wolfe Research Autonomy Summit 2026. For KDK. KDK announced an appearance: Kodiak to Join Fireside Chat at the Wolfe Research Autonomy Summit.

January 2027
- DATES SET, NOW PRESENTING: ONDS - Jan 12-15: Needham Growth Conference (29th). Presenting: ONDS. Also for DPRO, SPAI. The growth conference small caps use in January.
- Jan 6-9: CES 2027, Las Vegas, NV. For AUR, KDK. Autonomy and robotics launches cluster at CES.

Later (Jun 2027 to May 2028): MOVED - XPONENTIAL 2027 (Jun); Paris Air Show 2027 (Jun); DATES SET - XPONENTIAL 2028 (May).

Dates not posted yet: DSI Loitering Munitions Systems Summit 2027 (expected Sep 2027).
